description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EligibleLeaveTypeAPI within the OrangeHRM leave API module. It contains test methods that verify the behavior of the API, such as fetching all eligible leave types and ensuring certain methods throw not implemented exceptions. It extends a test case base class and uses various utility methods for setting up test conditions.

classes.name: EligibleLeaveTypeAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the EligibleLeaveTypeAPI endpoints and behavior.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all eligible leave types via the API, using data provider for different test scenarios.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data for the testGetAll method, sourcing test scenarios from a YAML file.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the create method of the API throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the getValidationRuleForCreate method throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.description: Verifies that the delete method of the API throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.description: Verifies that the getValidationRuleForDelete method throws a NotImplementedException.
